idea-plugin.name: Hospital Price Transparency MRF Lint
idea-plugin.description:
15 offline rules read your standard charges JSON the way 45 CFR Part 180 and the CMS template do - the dirty sample returns 17 findings, 15 errors

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Hospital Price Transparency MRF Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/hospital-mrf-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/hospital-mrf-lint

action.text: Hospital Price Transparency MRF Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Hospital Price Transparency MRF Lint on the file in the editor
